ignoreCommand: [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = production ] && exit 1; case "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" in preview/*) exit 1;; esac; case "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" in *"[preview]"*|*"[Preview]"*|*"[PREVIEW]"*) exit 1;; esac; echo "Preview skipped: add [preview] to the commit message or push a preview/* branch to build one"; exit 0
